def _event_schedule(event, user, schedule_next_run, rrule="DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY", **kwargs):
    return ScheduledEventExport.objects.create(
        event=event,
        owner=user,
        export_identifier='eventdata',
        export_form_data={},
        locale='en',
        mail_subject='Scheduled export',
        mail_template='Your export is attached.',
        schedule_rrule=rrule,
        schedule_rrule_time=time(6, 30),
        schedule_next_run=schedule_next_run,
        **kwargs,
    )


def _organizer_schedule(organizer, user, schedule_next_run, rrule="DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY"):
    return ScheduledOrganizerExport.objects.create(
        organizer=organizer,
        owner=user,
        export_identifier='customerlist',
        export_form_data={},
        locale='en',
        timezone='Europe/Berlin',
        mail_subject='Scheduled export',
        mail_template='Your export is attached.',
        schedule_rrule=rrule,
        schedule_rrule_time=time(6, 30),
        schedule_next_run=schedule_next_run,
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_dispatches_due_event_export(event, user):
    due = _event_schedule(event, user, datetime(2023, 1, 19, 5, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    later = _event_schedule(event, user, datetime(2023, 1, 25, 5, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    with freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00+00:00"):
        with mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_event_export.apply_async') as apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

        apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event.pk, 'schedule': due.pk})
        due.refresh_from_db()
        assert due.schedule_next_run == datetime(2023, 1, 20, 6, 30, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin"))
        later.refresh_from_db()
        assert later.schedule_next_run == datetime(2023, 1, 25, 5, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_sends_event_export_by_mail(event, user):
    s = _event_schedule(event, user, datetime(2023, 1, 19, 5, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    with freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00+00:00"):
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == [user.email]
    assert djmail.outbox[0].subject == 'Scheduled export'

    s.refresh_from_db()
    assert s.error_counter == 0
    assert s.schedule_next_run > now()
